name: 5-HTP
effects: Direct serotonin precursor — bypasses rate-limiting tryptophan hydroxylase step
Used for depression, anxiety, sleep, appetite suppression — modest evidence
Nausea common, especially on empty stomach; start low
Combining with SSRIs/SNRIs/MAOIs/MDMA can cause serotonin syndrome
Long-term use may deplete dopamine — consider carbidopa or L-DOPA co-supplementation
Cardiac valvulopathy concern with very prolonged high-dose use (theoretical)
